products.product_description: Dreamland's Zaatar Chickpea Salad is packaged in poly bags with a generic label which declares "chickpeas, cumin, zataar, turmeric, dill, onion, garlic, parsley". Dreamland distributed bulk cases (2/5lbs. bags per case) to Haggen store. Bulk 5lbs. bags were not sold directly to consumers. Haggen stores unpacked 5lb. bags of chickpea salad into cold food pan at salad bar (without mixing with other ingredients), consumers packed product in grab & go containers, and Haggen applied scale label when members paid at the register.
